From the Channel Islands, Martin takes a 2,000-mile journey across the States to Louisiana.

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of America
programme.desc: Next stop on Martin's island journey is the colourful Caribbean island of Puerto Rico, America's third-largest island, and the only one where Spanish is the main language. In 2017 Hurricane Maria ripped through the island causing the worst disaster in the island's history, flattening forests and houses and ultimately claiming thousands of lives. One year on Martin sees how the Puerto Ricans have begun to recover from the disaster.

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of America
programme.desc: Martin arrives in New York to explore Manhattan Island on the final leg of his journey, including its world-famous Empire State Building and nearby Ellis Island. programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Amanpreet and Mum make delicious pakora together for a special family meal to celebrate Vaisakhi. They set the table and exchange beautiful Vaisakhi cards with Dad.

programme.desc: Talented young chef Ben is cooking German zwiebelkuchen. Ben's parents are German, and zwiebelkuchen is a very popular recipe in Germany. It is one of Ben's favourite foods, so he is very happy to teach us all to make it. Zwiebelkuchen is an onion tart that is made from pastry, onions and German ham. Ben is adding lots of extra flavour by using caraway seeds.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie is at a train museum, finding out how train tracks work by moving trains from one track to another to get to the right place. She also gets to see how the signal box works.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Cocker Spaniel Diesel is a hearing dog for his teenage owner, Rayane, who is deaf. This means he doesn't hear everything. Diesel's super ears are trained to alert Rayane to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane's ears! On the way to the pet shop, he has to ignore lots of noises. He uses his super hearing to zoom in on the important sounds like the pet shop doorbell.

programme.title: Steve and Aneeshwar Go Wild
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar meet some agile gibbons who show them how well they can move. Though the gibbons are a little quiet, Steve and Aneeshwar have a go at showing what they sound like in the wild. Next, they meet a long-legged bird called a seriema.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Simon and Evie take Waffle for a walk and bump into Evie's friend Anaya and her mum, AJ. An overenthusiastic Waffle drags Simon through the park, soaking him under a sprinkler.
